result.summary: Full suite (scripts/test_parallel.sh, 16-way partitioned mix test) run 4 times on branch feature/WF03-ISS0292-20260823 (HEAD 26b8cce). Run 4 (clean): combined 1988 tests, 5 properties, 0 failures (1993/1993 passed), exit 0. Runs 1 and 3 each lost one partition to a Windows-host mix build-directory hard-link lock contention issue ('could not create hard link ... permission denied'), caused by other concurrent mix processes on the shared host, not this branch; every partition that did execute in those runs had 0 failures (run 1: 1723/1723 passed across surviving partitions; run 3: 1843/1843 passed). Run 2 surfaced one real failure: Letflow.SandboxPoolTest's pre-existing 'RT-6 (death path c)' test (test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs:1077), refute MapSet.member?(final, o_schema) failed after a Postgrex.Protocol/DBConnection.ConnectionError disconnect in the log immediately prior -- diagnosed as a timing flake under 16-way parallel DB-connection pressure, not caused by this branch's change: RT-6's own assertion logic is untouched by the diff (which only touches the cleanup helpers retry_query_once/1, resilient_drop_schema/1, and drop_sandbox_schemas_created_since!/1's teardown loop); re-running test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs alone (mix test test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs --seed 0) passed all 23 tests including RT-6 (Result: 23 passed); and the flake did not recur in runs 3 or 4. Full detail in test/reports/report-2026-08-23-WF03-ISS0292-20260823.yaml.
